claim_scope: Public final-delivery evidence for Track B controlled error discrimination.

controlled_cases.description: Seer knows P1 is a werewolf but does not publish the check result and votes elsewhere.

construction.visible_situation: Seer has private night result P1=werewolf; day discussion and vote are open.
construction.injected_action: Seer does not publish the P1 check result and votes for another target.
construction.conflict: Private wolf result is not converted into public evidence; known wolf is not voted out.

controlled_cases.description: Werewolf leaks wolf-side perspective and protects a checked teammate without public evidence.

construction.visible_situation: Public table has a seer accusation against P1; wolves need to maintain villager-perspective speech.
construction.injected_action: Werewolf speech leaks wolf-side perspective and protects the checked teammate without public evidence.
construction.conflict: Speech exposes wolf perspective and overprotects a teammate against public evidence.

controlled_cases.description: Werewolf leaves the exposed seer alive and attacks a low-value villager target.

construction.visible_situation: Exposed seer remains alive and can continue producing check information.
construction.injected_action: Werewolf attacks a low-value villager target instead of the exposed seer.
construction.conflict: Night kill does not suppress the high-value information role.

controlled_cases.description: Witch saves the night attack target with available antidote.

construction.visible_situation: Witch receives the night attack target and has antidote available.
construction.conflict: No conflict; action matches role information and camp benefit.
